53)bla ma drag po'i gter srung spu gri mched gsum gyi gtor 'bul ni/rang nyid gu ru drag por bsam:hūm̐/drag sgrub sprul pa'i klu btsan bdud/ /

tei:div.tei:p: bla ma drag po'i gter srung spu gri mched gsum gyi gtor 'bul ni/ rang nyid gu ru drag por bsam: hūm̐/ drag sgrub sprul pa'i klu btsan bdud// sngo dmar nag pa'i mdog can de// g.yas gsum ru mtshon sngo dmar nag /g.yon gsum sbrul zhags mda' gzhu dang*/ khram shing 'dzin te rta bcibs pa// sngo dmar nag pa'i mdog dang ldan/ beḍūr bswe dang lcags kyi khrab// 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mgyogs pa'i rta/ khams gsum skad cig nyid la bskor// rdul phran rnams kyang rtsis la 'debs// sprul pa 'bum dang dung phyur 'gyed// klu btsan bdud kyi sku mkhar nas// mched gsum 'dir gshegs mchod gtor bzhes// sde brgyad 'dul dang smyo 'bog 'dul// bgegs chen 'dul la sogs pa yi// bdag gi 'dul byed las rnams sgrubs// nad pa mdze po sri'u gso// bdag gis gang gso de sos mdzod// ser ba srung dang god kha srung*// bdag gis gang srung thub par srungs// dgra rkun jag pa zlog cing chings// gnod byed dgra bo myur du sod/ 54) /dam bcas bzhin du las mdzod cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ du bam tri shu la nā ga ra dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ i dam ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta sarba pū dza khā hi/ bsnyen sngags 'bru bcu bzhi bzla'o/ zhes pa'ang a rā gas so// dge'o//
